summary: Connects apps to users' bank accounts to retrieve account, transaction, identity and payment data.
access_note: Free Sandbox keys from the Dashboard; Production (and Limited Production) must be requested through the Dashboard.
blocker_note: Sandbox is free and self-serve, but live bank data needs Production access requested and approved through the Dashboard; end users also link accounts via Plaid Link.

evidence.quote: These may be sent either in the request body or in the headers PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET.
The Plaid Sandbox is a free and fully-featured environment for application development and testing.
The Plaid API is JSON over HTTP.
Access tokens for the MCP server expire after 15 minutes.

notes: Official MCP is a Dashboard MCP server (Production data only, limited support, under active development); it covers Dashboard/admin tasks, not end-user bank data. Production approval criteria were not shown on pages read, so the app_review rating leans on the 'request Production API access via the Dashboard' wording.
